# S5.6 — Land the C4 fleet adapters (§5i.1; R-2.12.6)

**Stacked on:** `svitali/harnessharness-s5.5` (PR #87) · **Do not merge — operator-controlled**

## Summary

Lands the C4/Stage-5 adapter layer for the fleet
organizational slice: generic signed-webhook
ingress with capability probes, the
out-of-process `work_source_adapter` L5 plugin
boundary with a packaged tracker fixture,
`FleetView` on both first-party surfaces with
the approval-inbox join, the fourteen fleet
metric declarations plus
`unowned_dispatch_count`, and the optional
`ext.effects.external_irreversible` ceiling.

**HUMAN-H2 was not provisioned at build time**
— per the ticket's own fallback rule, the
Stage-4 `memory` tracker fixture is the honest
proxy and `DF-S5.6-1` records the real-tracker
leg as owed. No test or document claims a live
tracker was exercised.

## What landed

- **`hh-fleet::ingress`** — signed webhook
  ingress: `hmac-sha256:<hex>` verification over
  the canonical payload, `key_ref` resolved
  broker-side (the key never lands in a ledger
  row, reply, or view), delivery-id and content
  occurrence keys per OQ-313, replay-window
  dedupe surfacing `skipped{duplicate_occurrence}`,
  closed schema decode.
- **`hh-fleet::capabilities`** — the tri-state
  probe (`unknown`/`declared`/`probed`/
  `probed_absent`); probing resolves `unknown`
  only, never downgrades `declared` (T-LCD-07);
  `push_delivery_id` is probed from delivery
  evidence.
- **`hh-fleet-adapter` (new crate)** — the L5
  boundary: the `work_source_adapter` class wire
  codec (`ops` ↔ canonical-JSON records), the
  host-side `PluginSourceAdapter`
  (`WorkSourceAdapter` over a `SourceChannel`,
  channel faults latching `SourceUnavailable`),
  and the plugin-side `TrackerLogic` trait
  (ADR-0180/0181; T-LCD-12 records-in/out).
- **`hh-tracker-fixture` (new crate +
  `plugins/hh-tracker-fixture` manifest)** — the
  packaged reference variant, `subprocess_confined`
  under `plugin_abi/1`, genuinely spawned through
  `hh-varhost` in the integration test.
- **`hh-fleet` engine** — `&mut` adapter verbs
  (poll consumes the ingress queue; faults
  latch); `list`/`get` read minimum;
  `activate_run` consulted by reconciliation; a
  source fault maps to `SourceUnavailable` and
  stops further polling; the optional
  irreversibility ceiling reserves one root-pool
  unit per `on.external_irreversible` dispatch
  (exhaustion → `blocked{irreversibility_ceiling}`
  + escalation; unset ⇒ no-op).
- **`hh-fleet::view`** — the ledger-derived
  `FleetView` (identity/state, activation refs
  + counts, blocked/handoff, escalations, budget
  consumed/remaining, `external_irreversible`
  count, open children, capacity, ownership,
  cues/suspended, `derived_from` watermark,
  totals by owner/source/state, `metrics` = the
  catalogue's fleet declarations).
- **`hh-embed/1`** — `fleet.webhook_ingress`,
  `fleet.source_capabilities`,
  `fleet.source_records` boundary ops (schema
  rows + regenerated client + export; lane
  selection fixture↔webhook; requester
  provenance stamped on boundary-initiated
  writes). Tier-absent ⇒
  `Unsupported{by: "tier-c4"}`.
- **`hh-telemetry` + `hh-ontology`** —
  `MetricLevel::{WorkItem, Fleet}`; the
  `FLEET_METRICS` catalogue — fourteen §5i.1
  declarations plus `unowned_dispatch_count`
  (the `veto: true` trace predicate).
- **`hh-web` + `hh-cli`** — V10 supervision
  renders `FleetView` verbatim and joins durable
  `security.permission.pending` rows onto items
  by `work_item_id` (`approval_inbox` kept whole
  for audit); `hh fleet` noun (view/items/item/
  reconcile/observe/capabilities/records/
  ingress).
- **`hh-registry`** — the `work_source_adapter`
  `ClassRecord` (contract ops + invariants +
  closed declaration schema; `tier: C4`).
